name.ja: Bトレインショーティー　スハ43系客車（青）
name.en: B Train Shorty Suha 43 series passenger car (blue)

description.ja: • 国鉄が1951年から製造した急行用客車。同系列は日本全国で活躍。
description.en: • Express passenger cars manufactured by JNR from 1951. The same series is active all over the country.

description.ja: • 晩年は地方幹線等の普通列車に使用。旧型客車の代表格となった。
description.en: • In the evening, it is used for local trains such as local trunk lines. It became a representative of old-style passenger cars.

description.ja: • スハ43形とスハフ42形（青色）のセット。
description.en: • A set of Suha 43 type and Suhafu 42 type (blue).
